hooks.name: pre-compact
hooks.purpose: Snapshots session state and tracks compaction bypasses before the context is compacted

hooks.name: delegate-host
hooks.purpose: Binds a one-shot host token to delegate/delegate_resume calls so the MCP handler can attribute the host session

hooks.name: rewrite
hooks.purpose: Rewrites Bash commands to run through tkr's output filters

hooks.name: agent-search-inject
hooks.purpose: Injects search context and work-routing advice into Agent spawns; applies the spawn veto

hooks.name: long-runner-warn
hooks.purpose: Warns before Bash commands that match known long-running patterns

hooks.name: cache-bust-warn
hooks.purpose: Estimates prefix-cache rebuild cost before edits to cache-critical files

hooks.name: skill-invoked
hooks.purpose: Applies the bundled-skill payload gate when a Skill is invoked

hooks.name: praxis-observe
hooks.purpose: Records tool activity after a Praxis consult without reading tool inputs

hooks.name: praxis-checkpoint
hooks.purpose: Consults the local Praxis knowledge base before an AskUserQuestion reaches the user; fail-open

hooks.name: pre-model-switch
hooks.purpose: Warns with the prefix-cache rebuild cost a model switch will incur

hooks.name: session-start
hooks.purpose: Session bootstrap: awareness context, skill audit, and background refreshes

hooks.name: post-tool-call
hooks.purpose: Compresses Bash output through the filter pipeline and records agent completions and nudges

hooks.name: cli-corrections
hooks.purpose: Suggests known CLI corrections after a failed Bash command

hooks.name: post-tool-batch
hooks.purpose: Classifies each tool batch and appends it to the ledger

hooks.name: user-prompt-submit
hooks.purpose: Records the prompt event and classifies it for work routing

hooks.name: subagent-outcome
hooks.purpose: Records the outcome of a finished subagent for routing evaluation

hooks.name: praxis-stop
hooks.purpose: Praxis stop checkpoint; always exits 0, and blocks only to hand advisory guidance back to the model

hooks.name: memory-health
hooks.purpose: Scans memory files for health problems (async rewake)

hooks.name: session-summary
hooks.purpose: Writes the session summary at turn end (async rewake)

hooks.name: keepalive-watch
hooks.purpose: Long-lived idle watcher that wakes the session before the prompt cache expires (asyncRewake, up to 3600s by design)

hooks.name: keepalive-cleanup
hooks.purpose: Removes this session's keepalive state; best-effort

hooks.name: team-push
hooks.purpose: Debounced aggregate-only team collection push; opt-in via managed [team] config

hooks.name: session-summary
hooks.purpose: Writes the final session summary at session end

hooks.name: instructions-loaded
hooks.purpose: Telemetry only: logs each CLAUDE.md / rules load for pd-audit
